title: Home-Site Lease Agreement: Monthly Rent of a Signed Twelve-Month Renewal
content:
**Clause — rent of a signed twelve-month renewal of the Home-Site Lease**

The monthly site rent written into a signed twelve-month renewal is the monthly site rent of the twelve-month renewal offer on the lease, taken as offered — the rent recorded on the most recent twelve-month renewal offer among the lease's notices — in US dollars to the cent.

**The clause restated**

| Input | Where it is read | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Monthly site rent of the twelve-month renewal offer | the most recent twelve-month renewal offer among the lease's notices | written into the signed renewal as offered |

"Taken as offered" means the rent recorded on the offer, not a rent refigured at signing from the current monthly site rent.

**Worked example (hypothetical)**

| Offer on the lease | Monthly site rent written into the signed twelve-month renewal |
|---|---|
| twelve-month renewal offer at 734.30 | 734.30 |
| two twelve-month renewal offers, the earlier at 726.10 and the most recent at 734.30 | 734.30 |

**Basis Q&A**

*If the current rent has changed since the offer was delivered, is the offer refigured?* No. The rent written into the signed twelve-month renewal is the rent of the offer, taken as offered.

*Which offer governs when the lease's notices carry more than one twelve-month renewal offer?* The most recent one.
